po_script.message: Retry policy from the payments team: max 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 25s), every attempt carries the same PSP idempotency key per order, and the cart is held for 5 minutes from the first failure. Retries stop on success or decline as written.

expected_turns.semantic_notes: Opening turn: engineering findings presented (retry policy unspecified, idempotency missing, order-hold behavior undefined), business positive; no conflicts; PO asked for the retry policy.

Engineering-only delegation with the PO-supplied retry policy as extra context (max 3 attempts, backoff 1s/5s/25s, PSP idempotency key per order, 5-minute cart hold); business v1 reused; review-engineering v2 resolves the gaps against the policy; readiness needs_work. Deterministic assertion: selected reviewer routing exactly matches this turn. Readiness gate finalizes same turn (normal readiness path, po_accepted=false): the post-delegation summary resolves every finding, so the session completes on this turn — no separate acceptance turn follows (gate rule: empty open_issues + invoke none).

required.topic: no idempotency guarantee for retried charges
